nodes.name: engine.factors.qlib158
nodes.description: Qlib 158 Alpha Factors — 158 quantitative alpha factors including BETA, CNTD, CNTN, CNTP, CORD, CORR, IMAX, IMIN, IMXD, K-line, MA, MAX, MIN, QTLD, QTLU, RANK, RESI, ROC, RSQR, RSV, STD, SUMD, SUMN, SUMP, VMA, VSTD, VSUMD, VSUMN, VSUMP, WVMA families across 5/10/20/30/60 period windows

nodes.name: engine.factors.registry
nodes.description: In-memory registry of all discoverable alpha factors supporting class-based and function-based patterns, AST metadata extraction, lazy instantiation, output validation, and JSON manifest export

nodes.name: FactorRegistry
nodes.description: In-memory registry of all discoverable alpha factors. Supports class-based AlphaFactor subclasses and function-based __alpha_meta__ + compute(panel) patterns. Provides discovery, lazy instantiation, output validation, health, summary, export_manifest

nodes.name: FactorHandle
nodes.description: Unified handle for both class-based and function-based factors providing common interface regardless of underlying factor pattern

nodes.name: engine.factors.technical
nodes.description: Technical alpha factors: Momentum, ROC, MeanReversion, RealizedVolatility, ATR, BollingerBandWidth, VolumeRatio, RSI, MACDHistogram

nodes.name: BridgeConfig
nodes.description: Configuration for the BH↔QNA bridge

nodes.name: BridgeResult
nodes.description: Result of a cross-module bridge operation with to_dict method

nodes.name: Bridge
nodes.description: Bridge that routes data between BH and QNA engine modules. Fetches market data from BH backtest infrastructure, runs QNA analysis, packages results for BH consumption, handles errors with configurable fallback logic, tracks latency and operation metrics

nodes.name: KellyBridge
nodes.description: Bridge that injects Kelly position sizing into a backtest strategy. Wraps base strategy, computes optimal Kelly fraction at each step, adjusts position sizes, tracks Kelly-derived risk metrics

nodes.name: KellySignalMixin
nodes.description: Mixin to add Kelly position sizing to any backtest strategy with adjust_position_size method

nodes.name: KellySignal
nodes.description: Output from Kelly calculator for a single period

nodes.description: Base Kelly criterion implementation with compute, _validate_probability, and _growth_rate methods

nodes.description: Bayesian Kelly criterion with effective sample size computation

nodes.name: engine.kelly.correlation
nodes.description: Correlation-aware Kelly criterion with single-asset Kelly computation for correlated assets

nodes.name: engine.kelly.drawdown
nodes.description: Drawdown-aware Kelly criterion adjusting position sizing based on current drawdown state

nodes.name: engine.kelly.fractional
nodes.description: Fractional Kelly criterion for conservative position sizing with fraction multiplier

nodes.name: engine.kelly.multi_asset
nodes.description: Multi-asset Kelly criterion for portfolio-level optimal position sizing across assets with fallback

nodes.name: engine.kelly.optimal_f

nodes.name: engine.llm_router
nodes.description: Multi-provider LLM router with failover, health monitoring, cooldown on failure, and cost tracking across OpenAI and other providers

nodes.name: LLMRouter
nodes.description: Multi-provider LLM router with automatic failover, health monitoring, cooldown on failure, and cost tracking. Supports add_provider, remove_provider, get_provider_health, get_cost_stats, chat

nodes.name: ProviderConfig
nodes.description: Configuration for an LLM provider including provider type, API key, and priority

nodes.name: engine.market_state
nodes.description: Market regime detection using price trend (linear regression slope), volatility, ADX approximation, and volume profile analysis to classify market regimes

nodes.name: MarketRegimeDetector
nodes.description: Detects the current market regime from price data using trend, volatility, ADX approximation, and volume profile analysis. Provides detect, history, current_regime, config, stats

nodes.name: RegimeResult
nodes.description: Result from a regime detection analysis with is_stressed method

nodes.name: engine.microstructure
nodes.description: Market microstructure analysis: VPIN (Volume-synchronized Probability of Informed Trading), Kyle's Lambda (price impact per order flow), Amihud Illiquidity Ratio, and aggregate MicrostructureAnalyzer

nodes.name: VPINCalculator
nodes.description: Volume-synchronized Probability of Informed Trading. VPIN = 1 - |2*V_buy - V_sell| / V_total over N volume buckets. Higher VPIN (>0.6) indicates informed trading

nodes.name: KylesLambda
nodes.description: Kyle's Lambda — price impact per unit of order flow. Regresses Δprice on signed_volume. Higher lambda = less liquid

nodes.name: AmihudRatio
nodes.description: Amihud Illiquidity Ratio — daily price response per unit volume. Amihud = mean(|r| / V_daily). Higher values indicate greater illiquidity

nodes.name: MicrostructureAnalyzer
nodes.description: Aggregate microstructure analysis combining VPIN, Kyle's Lambda, and Amihud ratios with realized and effective spread estimation

nodes.name: engine.ml.feature_engineer
nodes.description: Feature engineering for ML models creating comprehensive feature sets from OHLCV data, fundamental, sentiment, and macro data sources with feature selection, importance, and custom transform pipeline

nodes.name: FeatureEngineer
nodes.description: Feature Engineer for ML models. Creates comprehensive feature sets from OHLCV data and optional fundamental/sentiment/macro data. Includes technical, fundamental, sentiment, macro features, selection, importance, and custom transform pipeline

nodes.name: engine.ml.model_manager
nodes.description: Model Manager for ML models with registration, versioning, training pipeline, inference with latency tracking, health monitoring, and model persistence

nodes.name: ModelManager
nodes.description: Model Manager for ML models with model registration with versioning, training pipeline with metrics, inference with latency tracking, model health monitoring, and model persistence (save/load)

nodes.name: engine.models.base
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all ML models with PredictionResult, BaseModel abstract class defining train(X, y), predict(X), feature_importance(), validate_input interface

nodes.name: BaseModel
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all ML models. Every model must implement train(X, y), predict(X), feature_importance(), validate_input

nodes.name: PredictionResult
nodes.description: Result from a model prediction with signal, confidence, probabilities, features_used, model_name

nodes.name: engine.models.ensemble
nodes.description: Ensemble ML models: Simplified Random Forest (pure numpy/pandas without sklearn), Simplified Gradient Boosting, and EnsembleModel combining RF + GBM with confidence-weighted averaging

nodes.name: SimpleRandomForest
nodes.description: Simplified Random Forest using decision stumps with pure numpy/pandas, no sklearn dependency. Uses collection of decision trees with random feature subsets

nodes.name: SimpleGradientBoosting
nodes.description: Simplified Gradient Boosting implementation that sequentially fits trees to residuals of previous predictions

nodes.name: EnsembleModel
nodes.description: RF + GBM Ensemble Model combining Random Forest and Gradient Boosting predictions using confidence-weighted averaging

nodes.name: engine.models.feature_store
nodes.description: Feature Store for ML models managing feature engineering, transformation, storage, normalization, caching, selection, and lookahead prevention

nodes.name: FeatureStore
nodes.description: Feature Store for ML Models managing feature engineering, transformation, storage, normalization (z-score, min-max), feature caching for performance, feature selection, and automatic lookahead prevention

nodes.name: engine.models.signal_generator
nodes.description: ML Signal Generator converting ML model predictions into actionable trading signals with multi-model aggregation, confidence-based position sizing, risk-adjusted filtering, and signal strength normalization

nodes.name: SignalGenerator
nodes.description: ML Signal Generator taking ML model predictions and converting them into actionable trading signals with risk-adjusted position sizing, multi-model aggregation, confidence-based sizing, and signal strength normalization

nodes.name: TradingSignal
nodes.description: A trading signal with position recommendation including symbol, direction (long/short/neutral), strength, confidence, suggested_size, models_agree, metadata
